company.shortDescription: FactIQ provides an AI-powered platform to search, analyze, and visualize official economic and financial data.
company.description: FactIQ provides an AI-powered platform for searching, analyzing, and visualizing official economic and financial data. The platform aggregates millions of data series from government agencies and global institutions into a searchable interface. Users can ask questions in plain English and receive sourced answers with charts, tables, and narrative reports. FactIQ generates publication-ready articles and scheduled research reports using time series from labor, trade, prices, productivity, markets, and other indicators. The product supports dashboards, live charts, and exports to formats such as PNG and CSV. It is designed for analysts, journalists, policy professionals, and business users who work with public economic data and need transparent methods and citations for their analysis.
